subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: Should OpenClaw show redacted tool failure reasons and retry/recovery confirmations in user-visible chat by default, or keep those details internal unless an explicit trusted/verbose policy allows them?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the safe default depends on maintainer policy for channel trust, redaction, mutating side effects, and operator-facing recovery semantics.

options.title: Adopt redacted recovery-aware chat policy
options.body: Surface sanitized failure reasons and recovered notices only for allowed tools/channels and matched successful retries.

options.title: Keep details internal by default
options.body: Continue suppressing ordinary raw reasons in chat and rely on agent summaries, diagnostics, or verbose/trusted modes for detail.

options.title: Split reason and recovery work
options.body: First define a narrow redacted reason policy, then track retry-success confirmation under the broader native recovery issue.

recommendation.title: Adopt redacted recovery-aware chat policy
recommendation.body: Surface sanitized failure reasons and recovered notices only for allowed tools/channels and matched successful retries.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-history owner on the payload-warning and retry-clearing path.
